briefings.title: How Meesho Became India’s Biggest Shopping App
briefings.tldr: Meesho became India's dominant Android shopping app by relentlessly focusing on mass-market consumers and pivoting its business model through five distinct iterations—transitioning from a localized directory to a WhatsApp social commerce tool, and finally to a direct-to-consumer e-commerce giant processing 2.5 billion annual orders.

briefings.title: Why Two IIT Engineers Turned Down $550K Jobs To Build A Startup
briefings.tldr: Varun Vummadi turned down a $550,000 quant finance offer and a Stanford PhD to build GigaML, eventually leveraging Y Combinator's network and a lean 8-person team to secure major enterprise clients like DoorDash over well-funded, 400-person competitors.

briefings.title: Beyond Bigger Models: Recursion As The Next Scaling Law In AI
briefings.tldr: Recursive AI models like Hierarchical Reasoning Models (HRM) and Tiny Recursive Models (TRM) achieve state-of-the-art reasoning performance—outperforming models 1,000x their size on tasks like the ARC Prize—by utilizing weight reuse and latent memory states at inference time to bypass the "reasoning ceiling" of standard feed-forward LLMs.
